cbd_personal_care_and_cooking.summary: CBD, body-care, and cooking products are final sale because they are consumable or personal-care items.

damaged_or_incorrect_orders.summary: Contact support within 7 days of delivery with the order number and photos. Replacement or refund requests are reviewed individually.
required_information: Photos of the item and packaging

physical_books.summary: Physical books may be returned within 14 days if unused and in their original condition.
physical_books.return_shipping: Customer pays return shipping unless the order was damaged or incorrect.

digital_products.summary: Digital products and downloaded books are final sale after delivery or download.

courses.summary: A course refund may be requested before course access is delivered. Courses are final sale after access, materials, or participation begins.

subscriptions.summary: Subscriptions renew monthly until canceled. Customers can cancel through their account profile or email support if they are unable to cancel there.
subscriptions.self_service: Cancel through the customer account profile.
subscriptions.assisted_cancellation: If profile cancellation is unavailable or unsuccessful, email budlysupport@gmail.com.
subscriptions.processed_orders: Orders already processed are not automatically refundable.

shipping.summary: Shipping rates and available destinations appear at checkout. Delivery dates are estimates and are not guaranteed.
shipping.unsupported_destination: If an order cannot be fulfilled to the selected destination, the affected order is refunded.

nft_memberships.summary: Membership begins when the transaction finishes processing. Customers have 7 days to cancel for a full refund if the membership has not been used.
nft_memberships.activation: Membership begins as soon as the transaction finishes processing.
nft_memberships.usage_rule: Using a membership discount counts as using the membership and disqualifies the purchase from a refund.
nft_memberships.financial_disclaimer: Membership does not promise financial return, resale value, or appreciation.
nft_memberships.benefits_rule: Membership benefits are limited to the terms displayed at purchase.

wholesale.summary: Prices, minimums, shipping, labeling, and commercial terms that can be fulfilled through the website may be completed there. Anything outside the website's available options may require support assistance.
